name: chunk_state_varlen
description: Variable-length final-chunk state accumulation with signature chunk_state_varlen(B, x, dt, dA_cumsum, cu_seqlens, chunk_states). B is [total_tokens,ngroups,dstate], x is [total_tokens,nheads,headdim], dt/dA_cumsum are [nheads,nchunks,chunk_size], cu_seqlens is the length-(batch+1) sequence offset array, and chunk_states is [nchunks,nheads,headdim,dstate]. For each sequence, take its final chunk, map each head to its group, and accumulate x * B * exp(dA_last - dA_cumsum) * dt over the in-chunk token span from max(start,chunk_start) to end. Return a newly allocated tensor [batch,nheads,headdim,dstate] with dtype chunk_states.dtype; chunk_states supplies the output dtype and is not read or modified. This path does not propagate state across chunks; the suite builds sequences that do not straddle chunk boundaries. x/B/chunk_states are exercised as bfloat16 with float32 dt/dA.
